One PageDown changed the status to `Stage 3 of 5: Dome opens`; a second PageDown changed it to `Stage 5 of 5: Drawn`, directly showing progressive opening tied to downward scrolling.

active_results.rationale: The observed status traversed the same sampled stages in reverse when the scroll direction reversed (Whole → Dome opens → Drawn, then Drawn → Dome opens → Whole), and a mid-stage remained stable when scrolling stopped. This directly satisfies bidirectional scroll tracking and rules out an autonomous timer sequence.
